response.justification: Bogdan is a seasoned, versatile software engineer with 15+ years of experience across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure domains, and holds a relevant CS degree. However, his AI/GenAI experience is minimal — limited to a few months in his current role touching MCP tooling and agentic workflow frameworks — with no demonstrated experience in RAG architectures, vector databases, Python, or building AI systems on cloud platforms, all of which are core requirements for this Staff Forward Deployed Engineer role.
strengths: 15+ years of full-stack engineering experience across diverse platforms and languages
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and workshop/training delivery experience
Currently exposed to MCP and agentic workflow tooling in his present role
concerns: No evidence of RAG architecture or vector database experience, both explicit requirements
AI-specific experience appears to span only a few months, far short of the required 8+ years in AI-driven solutions
No demonstrated Python usage or AI system design on major cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure)

key_factors.factor: Insufficient depth of AI-specific experience (8+ years required)
Strong general engineering and leadership background
